newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-N.Z. 105-8 AT LUNCH ON LAST DAY VS ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-N.Z. 105-8 AT LUNCH ON LAST DAY VS ENGLAND.

text.p: New Zealand were 105 for eight wickets in their second innings and still needing 26 runs to make England bat again at lunch on Tuesday, the last day of the first test at Eden Park.
New Zealand first innings 390. Second innings 105 for eight wickets (P.Tufnell 3-18).
England first innings 521 (overnight 366 for six) (A.Stewart 173, M.Atherton 83, G.Thorpe 119, D.Cork 59).
